summary: Two focused mechanisms: recover an explicit answer_action directive into a native call, and review zero-valued shell results against real files and patterns. L5 uses held-out task-family validation.
summary_zh: 两个专职机制：将明确的 answer_action 文本恢复为原生提交调用；遇到零结果时根据真实文件和模式复核。L5 使用任务族留出验证。

responsibilities.answer-call-repair: Recover an explicit JSON answer_action directive, preserving the original answer arguments.
responsibilities.zero-result-review: Trigger targeted file/pattern checks after a real zero result; zero can still be a valid answer.
